$comment: Per-project exa MCP server. Claude Code does not register it globally (see docs/adr/0003-scope-code-context-mcp-per-project.md). To opt a project in: copy this file to that project's repo root as `.mcp.json`, drop these `$`-prefixed comment keys, then approve the server when Claude Code prompts on first run (or list its name under `enabledMcpjsonServers` in the project's .claude/settings.json). exa reads EXA_API_KEY from your environment via ${EXA_API_KEY} expansion — export it (e.g. in your shell) before use.
